svg.text: The Cognition Fabric's only in-path node. Two outbound contracts, both terminating at CF. The proxy applies — it does not judge.
proxy in path — transparent or delegated
default flavor · Kubernetes sidecar injection · in-path node
MEDIATE — L9 conversations · tool / MCP / LLM calls · in-scope paths
Envoy Go HTTP filter — the mediation point
buffers the item · applies the returned Disposition
eBPF is correlation-only — it never enforces
Audit record — one per mediated item
submitted form · disposition · applied form · trace ID
a block record proves the upstream was never called
queryable: sidecar admin API · operator aggregator · explorer UI
peer T3 — owns ingestion, trajectories, decisions
prior findings enrich the next submission
THE SUBMIT / DISPOSITION LOOP — this is the whole contract
enriched from SCOPE and the store
All implement the same submit / Disposition loop.
White-box: the app emits via an OpenTelemetry SDK.
Black-box: the proxy propagates traces itself.
Both are architecture of record — neither is a fallback.
It applies what the Enforcing tier returns. Analytics and
Active need no in-path component — only Enforcing does.
That is the entire reason this node exists.
